exclusion_policy_before_draw: Keep only unique URLs matching https://www.pragmaticplay.fun/en/slots/<lowercase-slug>/ extracted from official .game-card elements.
Require a Play Demo button carrying a non-empty game symbol.
Exclude any card explicitly marked upcoming or having a release date after 2026-10-19.
Exclude candy-rush because it was previously tested.
Do not filter by feature purchases, game age, mechanics, success prospects, or ease of testing.

eligible_urls_hash_format: UTF-8 sorted canonical URLs, joined by LF, with one final LF
seed_source: Python secrets.token_bytes(32), OS cryptographic random source; generated once after catalogue eligibility was frozen
sampling_method: Sample without replacement from eligible sorted ascending by canonical URL. For each draw calculate SHA256(ASCII fuzzer-five-sample-v1 followed by one NUL byte, then 32 seed bytes, then an unsigned 8-byte big-endian counter beginning at 0). Interpret digest as unsigned big-endian integer x. For current pool size n, reject x >= 2^256 - (2^256 mod n), incrementing counter for every digest. Select and remove element at zero-based index x mod n. Continue until 5 selections.
